paite: Huan TOUPA’N Mosi kiang ah, “Pharoah tung leh Aigupta gam tung ah gawtna khat ka tun lai ding. Huai khit chiang in hiai a pan ahon paisakta ding hi. Ahon paisak chiang in, hon hawlkhe siang sipsip ding hi.
heading: Mosi In Piang Masa Sih Ding Apuang

paite: Tu in mite zak in thu gen inla, pasal chih in a-inveng kiang ah ngen hen. Numei chih in a-inveng kiang ah dangka suangmantamte leh dangka-eng suangmantamte ngen hen," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Aiguptate mitmuh in mite deihsakna apia hi. Huai lou in Aigupta gam ah, Pharaoh sikhate mitmuh leh mite mitmuh in Mosi athupi mahmah hi.
Mosi in, "Hiai bang in TOUPA'N achi, zankim chiang in Aigupta gamsung teng ka tawnsuak ding hi.
Aigupta gam a piang masa tengteng, alaltutphah a tu Pharaoh tapa upapen a pan buhhek a om sikhanu ta masapen leh ganta piang masa tengteng asi ding uhi.
Aigupta gam pumpi ah kahna thupitak a-om ding a, huchibang om ngei nai lou, huchibang om ngei nawn lou ding.
Himahleh Israel suante lak a kuamah siatna ding in, mi hiam ganta hiam siatna ding in ui in alei atangsak kei ding a; TOUPA'N Aiguptate leh Israel akhentuamdan na thei ding hi.

Huai hun chiang in ka kiang ah na milian tengteng ahong paisuk ding ua, ahong kun ding ua, 'Nang hon zui mi tengteng toh paikhia un' ahong chi ding uh. Huai khit chiang in ka paikhe ding," chi in hehtak in Pharaoh a pan Mosi apaikhia hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ka thillamdangte Aigupta gam a apunna ding in Pharaoh in ahon ngaikhe kei ding," achi hi.
Mosi leh Aaron in Pharaoh ma ah hiai thillamdang tengteng ahihta ua; TOUPA'N Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a, gam a kipan Israel suante apaisak nuam tuan kei hi.
